tranches.name: Adapter SDK, Capability Manifest & Deterministic Reference VTT

active_contract.rule: VTI-01 may create only its evidence-backed acceptance package and governed public-source capability matrix until genuine matching Linux/Windows RED is sealed. Production mutation remains closed before that proof.

boundaries: external VTTs are clients/projections and never replacement rules authorities
VTI-01 is evidence-backed classification only; platform selection is evidence-driven and deferred to VTI-09
No vendor selection, ranking, winner recommendation or VTI-09 commitment is authorized
No credential use, external account mutation, provider activation, adapter implementation, external synchronization mutation or canonical game-state mutation is authorized
Capability state must remain explicit as supported, unsupported, conditional or unknown; missing or contradictory evidence is never inferred as support
No permission, ownership, consent, hidden-information or GM-authority bypass
native SSA/KFR/ODL/MAL/ALP state is projection-only in VTI
no durable VTI persistence, new migration or external synchronization ledger is authorized
VTI-02+, SGC-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized
